title.narrative: Joint Executive Program of a project to improve access to reproductive health services for displaced and vulnerable women and girls in Somalia

description.narrative: Reducing the mortality of children and pregnant women by providing reproductive health services in 15 centers distributed in several governorates, where 350,000 beneficiaries benefited from the project.

Supporting the resilience of the health sector in Somalia and preventing its collapse and increasing the number of births by providing incubators for needy cases and providing caesarean section services for needy cases and natural births in normal cases.

The project operates 15 reproductive health centers that provide health care to pregnant women and Somali girls in the Somali Republic. The project also includes securing anesthesia machines, incubators, medical equipment, and consumables necessary to provide reproductive health services to beneficiaries, in addition to securing medicines and antibiotics used to treat obstetrics and gynecology diseases. The project also includes operating the centers and paying the salaries of employees and workers and the operational costs, in addition to 3 surgical camps
